Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: OpenAI expands safety testing for Astra model over potential cyber risks | OpenAI 因潜在网络安全风险延迟 Astra 模型发布
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: AI 搜索和 Agent 技术的演进正受到安全合规的严重制约。Astra 的延迟意味着高度自主的 AI Agent 时代（能代替用户在网页上执行复杂操作）普及时间将被推迟。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: Official statement from OpenAI via TestingCatalog
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: OpenAI announced it has expanded safety testing for its upcoming Astra model because it 'cannot rule out' critical cyber capabilities. This safety threshold evaluation is expected to delay the public launch of the agentic model.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: 调整 2026 下半年的 Agentic SEO 规划，短期内仍应聚焦于基于检索的 AEO/GEO，而非全自动 Agent 交互。

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Google's 'goto' redirect test analyzed as anti-scraping measure | Google 的 'goto' 重定向测试被指旨在打击爬虫
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: 如果 Google 强制通过 JS 驱动的 'goto' 链接进行重定向，依赖住宅代理和简单 HTML 解析的第三方 SEO 工具及 AI 爬虫将无法准确记录点击，甚至可能被完全阻断。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: Expert analysis by Viktor Lofgren and Glenn Gabe
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Viktor Lofgren (Marginalia Search) notes that Google's 'goto' redirects rely on JavaScript to detect clicks. If a scraper uses residential proxies without executing JS or simulating real user clicks, Google sees a search with zero clicks, potentially poisoning the scraper's data or blocking them.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 监控爬虫与抓取工具的 JS 渲染配置，确保能正确处理 JS 重定向。

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Overstock.com relaunch fails to recover organic visibility after 2023 shutdown | Overstock 关停后重新上线，有机能见度未能恢复
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: 关停高权重域名并试图在后期重新启用的代价是致命的。历史累积的信任和爬网预算一旦归零，即使重新上线原域名，也无法简单找回原有的排名。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: Domain visibility tracking by Glenn Gabe
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Glenn Gabe tracked overstock.com's visibility trend following its 2023 shutdown and subsequent relaunch in 2024. The data shows a massive initial drop in organic visibility that has failed to recover, confirming that domain equity and crawl history cannot be easily paused and resumed.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 避免完全关闭高权重域名；若必须转型，应使用持续的 301 重定向保留路由，而非彻底下线。

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Study shows 91% of AI search citations appear on only one platform | 研究显示 91% 的 AI 搜索引用仅在单一平台出现
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 品牌在 Perplexity 获得引用并不意味着在 ChatGPT 或 Gemini 也会获得引用。GEO 策略必须针对不同引擎的独特索引和检索机制进行分发，单一平台的排名监控会导致策略盲区。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Kevin Indig's AI Halftime Report via Search Engine Journal
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Kevin Indig's AI Halftime Report analyzed AI search citations across major engines, revealing that 91% of citations are exclusive to a single platform. This highlights the extreme fragmentation of LLM-based retrieval sources compared to traditional Google SERPs.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 停止依赖单一 AI 引擎的可见性报告，建立覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity 的多引擎 GEO 监控。

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: KPMG report reveals 50% of executives delayed AI agent rollouts due to ROI | KPMG 报告显示近半数企业因 ROI 问题推迟 AI Agent 部署
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 企业端对 AI Agent 的降温意味着 B2B 流量生态中，由 Agent 自动执行的“无头流量”（headless traffic）增长速度可能慢于预期。
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: A KPMG survey of corporate executives revealed that nearly half have delayed or scaled back their AI-agent deployments. The primary driver for the pullback was that implementation and operational costs exceeded the measured benefits.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 在规划 B2B 网站的 Agent 友好度（如 schema、API 暴露）时，保持理性预算，优先服务人类用户的传统搜索需求。

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Retailers optimize sites for ChatGPT citations while driving direct checkout | 零售商优化 ChatGPT 引用并引导直接交易以留存数据
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: 在 AI 搜索时代，品牌既需要获取 LLM 的推荐（Citations），又必须防止用户在 AI 平台内完成闭环交易导致品牌失去一手数据（First-party data）。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence: Reuters report on retail consumer AI search tactics
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: Reuters reported on retailers optimizing their structured data and vendor listings specifically to appear in ChatGPT shopping results, while simultaneously designing user journeys that incentivize couples/users to book directly on their own sites to retain customer data.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 优化 Schema 标记以获取 AI 引用，但在落地页提供独家优惠或会员权益，吸引 AI 带来的流量直接在站内转化。
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 1. 针对高意向产品页，部署完整的 Product 和 Offer Schema 确保被 LLM 索引。2. 在这些落地页上部署“AI 读者专属”或“直接预订”的独家优惠/增值服务。3. 监控来自 ChatGPT/Perplexity 推荐流量的站内转化率。
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: 来自 AI 引擎引用的直接引流转化率（Direct Conversion Rate from AI Referrals）提升。
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 中等。需要调整 Schema 标记和落地页的转化漏斗设计。

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Technical SEOs advocate replacing heavy JS with native HTML/CSS features | 技术 SEO 倡导使用原生浏览器特性替代重度 JS 以提升能见度
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: 尽管 Google 能够渲染 JS，但重度依赖 JS 仍会消耗大量爬网预算并延迟索引。使用原生 HTML/CSS 特性替代 JS，可以显著提升页面加载速度和搜索引擎的抓取效率。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence: Expert analysis by Jono Alderson and Sitebulb
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: Technical SEO consultant Jono Alderson highlighted that many sites lose visibility due to unnecessary JavaScript. Replacing JS-driven elements with native browser features (like CSS Grid, native lazy loading, and HTML details/summary) reduces rendering overhead for search bots.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 审计网站上的 JS 依赖，将非交互性或简单的交互组件（如折叠菜单、延迟加载）替换为原生 HTML5 和 CSS3 特性。
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 1. 选取 20 个重度依赖 JS 渲染核心内容（如折叠常见问题、图片懒加载）的页面作为测试组。2. 将这些页面的 JS 组件替换为原生 HTML <details>/<summary> 标签和原生 loading="lazy"。3. 使用 Google Search Console 监控测试组页面的抓取到索引延迟时间（Crawl-to-Index latency）及 Core Web Vitals。
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: 抓取到索引的延迟时间缩短，以及 INP (Interaction to Next Paint) 指标改善。
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 中等。需要前端开发配合修改模板，风险极低。
